housing: Montreal is a city of renters, and many live in duplexes and triplexes (plexes) with outdoor staircases, as well as apartment buildings.

localRules.text: In Quebec a landlord cannot require a security or damage deposit; only the first month's rent can be asked in advance.

tenantHelp.name: Juridiqc
tenantHelp.what: Quebec government legal information for tenants

climate: Test the heating and check windows for drafts; also photograph outdoor stairs and balconies, which take a beating from winter ice.
fact: Many Montreal leases end on June 30, so July 1 is the city's main moving day.
